title: Programmable Kirigami Interfaces (Ph.D. Thesis)
summary: Soft, sensor-integrated electromechanical interfaces for acoustics, haptics, and physical reservoir computing.
description: My Ph.D. thesis work centers on programmable Kirigami interfaces — soft mechanical structures with integrated sensors, fabricated using layer-by-layer and geometry-driven design principles. This work spans multiple applications: acoustic and haptic interfaces, soft robotics, and physical reservoir computing. Add more detail here about your specific fabrication process, the physics/mechanics behind the geometry-driven design, and what makes this approach novel compared to rigid robotic systems.
highlights: Fabricated prototypes and mechanical assemblies with integrated sensors using layer-by-layer fabrication and geometry-driven design
Designed, built, and validated a low-power underwater physical reservoir computing sensor combining embedded sensors, piezoelectric materials, and DAQ systems
Developed an inflatable compliant Kirigami interface with embedded sensors for closed-loop feedback control of exoskeleton comfort

title: Reinforcement Learning of a Planar Micro-swimmer
summary: RL framework for a triangular micro-swimmer navigating viscous microscale fluid environments.
description: For my Bachelor's thesis, I developed and trained a reinforcement learning framework in Python to control a triangular micro-swimmer model operating in viscous, low-Reynolds-number fluid environments — with an eye toward future biomedical navigation applications, like microrobots navigating the body. Add more detail here: which RL algorithm you used, the swimmer's physical model, training setup, and results/performance.
highlights: Built a custom RL training environment simulating low-Reynolds-number swimmer dynamics

title: Machine Element Design Projects
summary: Seven mechanical design projects applying core machine design principles to real-world systems.
description: A series of seven mechanical design projects covering real-world engineering applications, including the design of a heavy-duty dump truck rear differential and gearbox/motor selection for a mine elevator. highlights: Designed a heavy-duty dump truck rear differential
